summary.text: Lord Haemon whom Nestor arrayed with mighty Pelagon, Alastor, Chromius, and Bias shepherd of the host — distinct from Haemon son of Creon in the Theban tragedies.

story.text: When Poseidon roused the army, Nestor the clear-voiced orator of the Pylians had drawn up his company around mighty Pelagon and Alastor and Chromius and lord Haemon and Bias, setting charioteers before the footmen.
